reviews.reason: The factory uses forwardRef to pass the package component ref through its surface-aware wrapper. The registry fixture requires a stable object default from concurrent loads. A bare function is not the same runtime export; the current import is not evidence of a broken API.

The public ES export is the lazy module loader, not the private NativeImgCrop wrapper. Consumers receive the default component and isolated stylesheet together through the registry; the loader and factory tests assert deferred style loading and stable default-module identity.
